title: LTO chief slams vlogger for helicopter stint

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief Marcus Lacanilao on Monday criticized vlogger Geo Ong for arriving at the agency’s Quezon City headquarters aboard a helicopter, saying public figures should set a good example rather than flaunt their wealth. Ong appeared before the LTO on Monday to address alleged traffic violations in Palawan, including riding a motorcycle without a helmet. The agency earlier suspended his driver’s license for 90 days after issuing him a show cause order.
